svg.title: BCBC 2024 · 9.9.6.4 Door Action
svg.text: BCBC 2024 · DIVISION B · PART 9 HOUSING AND SMALL BUILDINGS · SECTION 9.9 MEANS OF EGRESS
Door Action
WHAT THE CODE REQUIRES
Required exit doors and doors in required means of
egress swing on the vertical axis
Except doors in means of egress within dwelling units, and
as provided in Sentences (4) and (5).
Breakaway sliding doors installed as required exit doors
or required doors in means of egress are identified as
swinging doors by a label or decal affixed to the door
Except as provided in Sentence (5).
Revolving doors comply with Article 3.4.6.15.
Movable partitions separating a public corridor from an
adjacent business and personal services occupancy or a
mercantile occupancy need not conform to Sentence (1)
Provided they are not in the only means of egress. Note
A-3.3.1.12.(3): there should always be a second way out or a
swinging door within or adjacent to the sliding partitions.
Exit doors need not conform to Sentence (1) or (2) where
the doors serve
(a) accessory buildings where life safety is not adversely
affected, (b) storage garages or other accessory buildings
serving not more than one dwelling unit, or (c) storage
suites of not more than 28 m² (301 ft²) gross area in
warehousing buildings of not more than one storey, opening
directly to the exterior at ground level.
Drawn: four door types, one per numbered Sentence. Not to scale.
Source: BCBC 2024, Division B, Article 9.9.6.4. (page 9-49), with Note A-3.3.1.12.(3).
